books.title: Find Your Truth
books.author: Lou Redmond
books.description: Lou Redmond's account of his own search for a meaningful life, told through the best and worst decisions he made along the way. Alongside the story he sets out the steps he took and how readers can apply them, from turning struggles into passions to finding work that matters.
